prompts.task: Implement user CRUD with Prisma transactions
prompts.template:
Using NestJS and Prisma, implement a UserService with:
- createUser (with hashed password)
- findUserById (with posts relation)
- updateUserProfile (transactional: update user + log audit)

Available skills: {skills}
constraints: Return proper DTOs, not Prisma models

prompts.task: Fix N+1 query with Prisma include
Design Prisma schema for multi-tenant SaaS
prompts.template:
Design a Prisma schema for a multi-tenant blog platform with:
- Organizations (tenants)
- Users (belong to orgs)
- Posts (belong to orgs + users)
- Comments (belong to posts + users)
- AuditLog (tracks all mutations)

Available skills: {skills}
constraints: Use composite unique constraints on (orgId + slug)
